A large, aged world map with visible creases is hanging on the wall behind the visitor. The detective is pointing the stem of his pipe at a specific chess piece on the board. A sleeping bloodhound is lying on a rug under the small table. The fire in the fireplace is the brightest light. The visitor is holding a locked wooden box on their lap. The leather-bound books on the bookshelf appear significantly older and more worn than the visitor's polished wooden box. A violin case is leaning against the armchair. On the detective's desk to the right are two stacks of files. On the bookshelf to the left, the number of large leather-bound books is three times the number of file stacks. The locked box has an intricate metal latch. The detective is looking at the visitor. The violin case is closed. The detective is wearing a deerstalker hat.
